comment: The foundational shared data layer includes the LHR as a Phase 2 component but not the LIMR. The role of minimum semantic governance and information-model specifications during initial implementation remains unclear.

anchor.note: p.92 l.Lines 154-161 read as the printed page; section 4.2.2 agrees

public.text: The foundational shared data layer includes the LHR as a Phase 2 component but not the LIMR. The role of minimum semantic governance and information-model specifications during initial implementation remains unclear.
public.suggestedRevision: Require minimum governed data models, terminology bindings, versioning, and publication processes from the outset, even if a full LIMR platform is introduced later.
